import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    s = data[0]
    n = len(s)
    # p: first index equal to its left neighbour (n when s is already perfect)
    p = n
    for i in range(1, n):
        if s[i] == s[i - 1]:
            p = i
            break
    start = p if p < n else n - 1
    for i in range(start, -1, -1):
        for code in range(ord(s[i]) + 1, ord('z') + 1):
            c = chr(code)
            if i > 0 and c == s[i - 1]:
                continue
            rest = n - i - 1
            fill = ('ba' if c == 'a' else 'ab') * (rest // 2 + 1)
            print(s[:i] + c + fill[:rest])
            return
    print(-1)


main()
